W01 validates the W07 DTO and waits for W06 immutable membership.plan.published confirmation before returning success.

failurePolicy.missingW06AuditConfirmation: 503; publish intent is written before W07 mutation, and final published event is retried/reconciled using the deterministic plan-version event ID

operations.immutableVersioning: Append plan_version=current_version+1; never update/delete existing membership_plan_versions rows. Existing subscriptions retain the exact prior plan version accepted.
operations.successRule: W01 confirms a durable W06 update-request intent before W07 appends a version and CAS-updates the current pointer in D1-01. W01 validates the full W07 DTO and confirms the immutable W06 membership.plan.updated event before returning success.

failurePolicy.missingW06AuditConfirmation: 503; durable intent precedes mutation and final audit has a deterministic version ID

operations.ownerId: W08-resolved ACTIVE creator ID only; never taken from public body.
operations.lifecycle: pause ACTIVE/PUBLIC to PAUSED/PRIVATE; resume PAUSED/PRIVATE to ACTIVE/PUBLIC; retire PAUSED/PRIVATE to RETIRED/PRIVATE. An ACTIVE/PUBLIC plan must be paused before retirement. RETIRED plans cannot transition.
operations.effect: Controls future catalog visibility/new sales only; existing subscriptions and accepted plan_version remain unchanged.
operations.successRule: W01 confirms durable W06 intent before W07 owner-scoped D1-01 If-Match CAS and confirms the immutable W06 final event before success.

operations.ownerScope: W07 derives customer_id from the authenticated W02 principal. Results are intersected with local saved_payment_methods rows created by a verified payment_succeeded event for the same customer and merchant.
operations.responseData: Only safe card summary fields are exposed (payment method type, brand, last4, expiry month/year, createdAt, and LuckRead mandate/removal state: ACTIVE, SETUP_PENDING, NO_RECURRING or REVOCATION_PENDING). Never expose payment_method_id, payment_token, card_token, PAN, CVC, client secrets, merchant ID, or provider mandate ID.

operations.ownerScope: D1-04 saved_payment_methods row must match authenticated W02 customer ID and configured Hyperswitch merchant.
operations.idempotency: Idempotency-Key: stable resource-derived key 'remove_' + savedPaymentMethodId; the key survives app reloads and binds the one-way removal request.
operations.successRule: W01 first confirms durable W06 payment_method.revocation_requested intent. The first W07 invocation writes only the D1-04 revocation request (one write transaction), immediately blocking all new MIT renewal selection, and returns 202 without provider I/O. W01 clients then replay DELETE with the same Idempotency-Key in a separate request. That replay performs Hyperswitch mandate revocation and vault deletion, then uses at most one D1-04 write transaction to persist provider deletion acknowledgement. Local payment_mandates rows become REVOKED only through a matching signature-verified mandate_revoked webhook; the public response remains 202 until all linked mandates are terminal and provider method deletion is durably confirmed.
operations.replay: The saved method has one durable revocation request. The initial request only establishes the local MIT block; only a replay with the exact original Idempotency-Key may reattempt provider revoke/delete operations. APP/H5 derive the key deterministically from savedPaymentMethodId so retries survive reloads. A different key for the same method, or reuse of the same customer key on another method, returns 409. No replay creates a second local request or mandate.

failurePolicy.idempotencyKeyMismatch: 409; only the exact original key can replay the saved method revocation request

operations.successRule: W07 creates the Order atomically in D1-04 only after authoritative item, immutable version, price, discount and tax decisions are admitted. W01 validates the complete response and waits for W06 D1-03 durable audit confirmation before returning any 2xx response. Until the pricing/tax adapter is admitted, W07 must return 503 without order writes.

query.cursor: optional opaque endpoint-scoped keyset cursor; maximum 2048 characters

operations.ownerScope: W01 authorizes order.read for the W02-authenticated principal; W07 independently filters D1-04 orders by the same server-derived customerId. A cursor is never an owner credential.
operations.ordering: created_at DESC, order_id DESC; stable keyset continuation.
operations.responseAuthority: W07 D1-04 Order rows and a correlated latest-payment lookup from the same D1-04 payments table. Return orderId, latestPaymentId (the newest attempt for the same customer and order, or null), status, version, currency, subtotal/discount/tax/total minor amounts and createdAt/updatedAt. latestPaymentId is only a navigation reference to the separately authorized GET /payments/{paymentId}; it does not assert success. Exclude customerId, provider/merchant IDs, provider references, payment credentials, client secrets, mandate/vault references and internal item snapshots.

operations.ownerScope: W01 authorizes order.read for the W02-authenticated principal; W07 independently queries D1-04 by both orderId and the same server-derived customerId. Cross-owner requests return RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.
operations.responseAuthority: W07 D1-04 Order and OrderLine rows only; DTO excludes customerId, provider fields, payment credentials and internal snapshots.

pathParameters.paymentId: required stable pay_ identifier; no client owner/merchant fields

operations.customerId: Derived only from the W02-authenticated W01 session principal; W07 independently queries D1-04 by payment_id and customer_id. Foreign and absent payments both return 404.
operations.responseAuthority: Payment.status, version and providerUpdatedAt come only from the validated W07 D1-04 Payment row. A separate providerStatus observation may be returned after a forced Hyperswitch GET, but it never changes D1-04 status, confirms an Order, or grants/revokes an entitlement.
operations.successRule: W01 validates the exact W07 owner-scoped DTO before returning it. Only W07's existing signed Hyperswitch webhook path advances persisted payment status; a provider status mismatch remains an observation and is explicitly labelled.

failurePolicy.providerUnavailable: 200 with last persisted D1-04 state and providerStatusCheck=UNAVAILABLE

requestBody.orderId: Existing Order identifier; no totals or provider fields accepted

operations.customerId: Derived only from the W01 session principal; W07 independently verifies customer ownership against D1-04
operations.amountAndCurrency: Read from the customer-owned Order and persisted payment attempt in W07 D1-04; never accepted from the browser
operations.pricingMode: Demo mode is derived from the immutable server-owned OrderLine snapshot; demo orders are payable only against an explicitly configured Hyperswitch sandbox. Live mode requires the admitted production pricing/tax adapter.
operations.provider: Hyperswitch payment intent with customer_id and setup_future_usage=off_session; browser confirmation is handled only by the official hosted Payment Element
operations.consent: Hyperswitch-hosted checkout must present its explicit save-method choice when supported. This operation does not persist mandate or consent facts; reusable-method storage remains gated on verified provider evidence and the following D1-04 module.
operations.responsePolicy: Return only an unconfirmed, owner-matched intent and the scoped clientSecret needed by the hosted SDK. Cache-Control no-store; never return provider API keys or raw payment credentials.
operations.successRule: W01 validates the bounded W07 response and order identity before returning the scoped SDK clientSecret. W07 D1-04 remains authoritative for payment attempts; neither client confirmation nor redirect grants subscription entitlement.

operations.authentication: W07 verifies X-Webhook-Signature-512 with the configured Hyperswitch HMAC-SHA512 secret against the exact raw request bytes.
operations.deduplication: W07 D1-04 unique provider + merchant + event ID; differing payload SHA-256 is recorded as a conflict.
operations.acknowledgement: 200 for applied/duplicate receipts; 202 for durably recorded reconciliation; 4xx for invalid signatures/transport; 503 when durable receipt cannot be persisted.

operations.authentication: W07 checks the exact RevenueCat Authorization header configured in the RevenueCat dashboard for every request. When HMAC signing is enabled in the dashboard and REVENUECAT_WEBHOOK_SIGNING_SECRET is configured, W07 additionally requires X-RevenueCat-Webhook-Signature HMAC-SHA256 over the exact raw bytes and the supplied request timestamp.
operations.deduplication: W07 D1-04 unique app_id + event.id; identical payload SHA-256 is a duplicate; differing payload SHA-256 is stored in a separate immutable conflict record.
operations.acknowledgement: 200 only after durable receipt or conflict persistence; 200 for idempotent duplicates and dashboard TEST event; 4xx for invalid authorization/signature/transport/payload; 503 when configuration or durable persistence is unavailable.
operations.entitlementEffect: NONE; webhook receipt never directly creates a payment, subscription, or entitlement. A later reconciliation worker must re-read RevenueCat subscriber state through its server API.

pathParameters.paymentId: required stable pay_ identifier; no client owner or merchant fields

operations.customerId: Derived only from the W02-authenticated W01 session principal; W07 independently filters D1-04 by payment_id and customer_id.

requestBody.amountMinor: Positive safe integer in the currency's smallest unit.
requestBody.reason: Optional bounded customer reason; no client-supplied customer, provider, merchant, currency or amountCaptured fields.

operations.idempotency: Idempotency-Key is mandatory. D1-04 reserves one stable refund_id per customer-scoped key and a semantic request hash. Reusing the same key with different payment, amount, currency or reason conflicts.
operations.capturedAmount: W07 force-refreshes the exact Hyperswitch payment; requires matching payment_id, customer_id (when supplied), merchant_id, amount, currency and payment status. It persists monotonic provider-reported amount_captured_minor in D1-04, then atomically reserves the refund amount only when all active INITIATING/pending/review/succeeded reservations plus the new request do not exceed the captured amount. Hyperswitch independently checks actual captured balance.
operations.providerCall: W07 invokes the existing Hyperswitch /refunds API outside D1 writes, using the persisted stable refund_id as the provider idempotency key. A network timeout leaves the local INITIATING reservation; retry uses the same Idempotency-Key and refund_id.
operations.responseAuthority: W07 D1-04 Refund row. The safe response contains refundId, paymentId, amountMinor, currency, reason, status, version, providerUpdatedAt, createdAt, updatedAt, replayed and statusAuthority. No provider tokens, merchant ID or connector raw response.
operations.financialEffect: NONE in this module. Provider refund state does not post/reverse Ledger facts and does not itself revoke W03/W07 subscription entitlement in D1-01; those are separate authorized workflows.

preProviderMutationAudit.order: W01 must receive W06 200 exact replay or 201 durable event confirmation before calling W07. On W06 failure/conflict W01 must not invoke W07.
preProviderMutationAudit.actor: W06 derives actor from W01 trusted private transport; body must not supply actor identity.
preProviderMutationAudit.idempotency: Event ID is deterministic from actorId, paymentId and Idempotency-Key digest; W06 checks exact amount semantics. Raw key is not persisted.

pathParameters.refundId: required stable ref_ identifier; no client owner or merchant fields

operations.ownerScope: W07 filters refunds by refund_id and the W02-derived customer_id. Missing and foreign refunds are both RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND/404.
operations.responseAuthority: Read-only W07 D1-04 Refund row. This endpoint does not call Hyperswitch or update any payment/refund/ledger/entitlement state.

trustBoundary.authentication: W01 resolves the session through its established session principal path; W08 independently resolves the same session through W02 before authorizing creator plan operations.
trustBoundary.authorization: W08 CASL evaluates membership.plan.create.own or membership.plan.read.own from W02-resolved identity, current account state, and persisted L0-L8 role context.
trustBoundary.creatorIdentity: W08 loads creators.creator_id where user_id matches the W02 principal and status is ACTIVE. W01 sends that resolved identity over the private W07 Service Binding. Public client-supplied creator IDs are ignored/rejected.
trustBoundary.planData: W07 D1-01 owns plan and immutable plan-version rows. New plans start private and DRAFT; public catalog exposes only ACTIVE + PUBLIC plans with an existing current immutable version.
trustBoundary.billing: Public user payment-intent and commerce operations remain separately permissioned. For provider callbacks, W01 relays bounded raw bytes/signature only; W07 performs HMAC verification and owns durable event/payment state. A provider callback does not itself grant D1-01 entitlement.

security.creatorPermissionAuthority: W08 CASL; identity/role authority remains W02 Better Auth
